findings.title: Chart-root/ancestor symlinks can redirect copied helper replacement into product source
findings.requiredCorrection: Bounded root/parent no-follow identities before traversal and every controlled write; reject chart/archive root and ancestor links and broken write destinations; allow only declared dependency link as recorded entry; extend actual-function controls.

findings.title: Reused numeric child PID/new start incorrectly becomes unit-owned
findings.requiredCorrection: Direct-child/start proof for initial child, matching original/known PID-start roots only for subsequent ownership/descendant closure; preserve known reparented roots and independent unjoined-role UNKNOWN checks; no ownership transfer on PID reuse.
